### Modals (shared across admin pages)

#### Points Modal
- Title: "Add Points" or "Deduct Points" depending on context
- Fields:
  - Member name (read-only display box, `#12121F` background)
  - Points (number input, required, min 1)
  - Category (select: Bonus, Streak, Adjustment, Penalty)
  - Reason (text input, required)
- Submit: Primary button, full width, "Confirm"

#### Warning Modal
- Title: "Issue Warning"
- Fields:
  - Member name (read-only)
  - Reason (textarea, 3 rows, required)
- Submit: Danger button, full width, "Issue Warning"

---

## PAGE 8: MEMBER MANAGEMENT (`admin/members.html`)

### Layout
- Nav bar (admin variant)
- 2-column grid: 320px sidebar | 1fr main content, gap 20px

### Left Sidebar: Add Hunter Card
- Card header: "➕ Add Hunter"
- Form fields stacked:
  - Full Name (text input)
  - Username (text input)
  - Password (text input — note: shown as plain text for admin creation ease, or use password type)
  - Role (select: Member, U5 Coordinator, Admin)
- Submit: Primary button, full width, "Create Hunter"

### Right: All Hunters Card
- Card header: "👥 All Hunters"
- Full-width data table
- Columns: Name | Username | Role | Rank | Points | Status | Actions
- **Role:** Inter 0.85rem, `#E8E8F0`
- **Actions:** "Edit" (secondary small) + "Deactivate" (danger small)
- Empty state: "No members found"

---

## PAGE 9: TASK ASSIGNMENT (`admin/assign-tasks.html`)

### Layout
- Nav bar (admin variant)
- 2-column grid: 320px sidebar | 1fr main content, gap 20px

### Left Sidebar: Assign Quest Card
- Card header: "➕ Assign Quest"
- Form fields:
  - Title (text input, required)
  - Duration in hours (number input, step 0.5, min 0)
  - Deadline (datetime-local input)
  - Priority (select: Low, Medium, High)
  - Assign To (select dropdown, populated with member list: "Name (username)")
- Submit: Primary button, full width, "Assign Task"

### Right: Active Quests Card
- Card header: "📋 Active Quests"
- Full-width data table
- Columns: # | Title | Assigned To | Deadline | Priority | Status | Rate
- **Priority:** Chip (low=muted, medium=blue, high=red)
- **Rate column:**
  - If status === completed: Dropdown select with options:
    - "Rate..." (default)
    - "Needs Revision (+3)"
    - "Meets Expectation (+5)"
    - "Exceeds Expectation (+8)"
  - Otherwise: `-`
- On select change: Auto-submits rating, shows toast, refreshes page

---

# PART 3: INTERACTION & STATE SPECIFICATIONS

## Hover States
- **Cards:** Border brightens to `rgba(79,195,247,0.4)`, glow shadow appears, translateY(-2px), top accent line fades in
- **Table rows:** Background shifts to `rgba(79,195,247,0.03)`
- **Nav links:** Color → `#4FC3F7`, border appears, subtle background
- **Buttons:** See component section above
- **Rank badges:** Glow intensifies slightly

## Focus States
- **Inputs:** Border `#4FC3F7`, blue glow shadow, outline removed
- **Buttons:** Same as hover plus subtle inner shadow

## Active / Pressed States
- **Buttons:** Scale 0.98, slightly darker
- **Nav links:** Background `rgba(79,195,247,0.1)`

## Loading States
- **Buttons:** Text changes to action + "...", opacity 0.7, disabled cursor
- **Pages:** Full-screen overlay with "SYSTEM INITIALIZING..." text (Bebas Neue, `#4FC3F7`, pulse-glow animation) + animated gradient bar

## Empty States
- Centered vertically and horizontally within container
- Icon: 3rem, `#4A4A6A`, opacity 0.5
- Text: Inter 0.9rem, `#4A4A6A`
- No borders or backgrounds — clean negative space

## Disabled States
- Opacity: 0.5
- Cursor: not-allowed
- No hover effects

---

# PART 4: CONTENT DATA MAPPING

## Member Dashboard Content Sources
| UI Element | API Endpoint | Field |
|---|---|---|
| Rank badge | `GET /members/{id}` | `rank` |
| Rank label | Derived | `getRankLabel(rank)` |
| Total points | `GET /members/{id}` | `points_total` |
| Progress bar | Derived | `getRankProgress(points, rank)` |
| Next rank text | Derived | `getNextRankThreshold(rank)` |
| Presence streak | `GET /members/{id}` | `streak_presence` |
| Reporting streak | `GET /members/{id}` | `streak_task_reporting` |
| Week earned | `GET /members/{id}` | `points_this_week` |
| Month total | `GET /members/{id}` | `points_this_month` |
| Today's tasks | `GET /tasks/today` | Array |
| Recent logs | `GET /points/logs` | Last 10 |
| Position | `GET /leaderboard/weekly` | Index of member |

## Admin Dashboard Content Sources
| UI Element | API Endpoint |
|---|---|
| Team table | `GET /members/` |
| Alerts | Derived from member list (points < 100, warnings >= 2) |
| Add points | `POST /points/add` |
| Deduct points | `POST /points/deduct` |
| Issue warning | `POST /warnings/` |

## Task Assignment Content Sources
| UI Element | API Endpoint |
|---|---|
| Assignee dropdown | `GET /members/` |
| Task list | `GET /tasks/` |
| Create task | `POST /tasks/` |
| Rate task | `PUT /tasks/{id}` |

---

# PART 5: ACCESSIBILITY & CONSIDERATIONS

- All interactive elements have visible focus states (blue glow)
- Color is not the sole indicator — icons and text accompany status chips
- Tables are wrapped in scrollable containers for mobile
- Modals trap focus while open
- Toast notifications are screen-reader friendly (single live region)
- Sufficient contrast ratios maintained (text `#E8E8F0` on `#0D0D1A` ≈ 12:1)

---

*End of Design Specification v2.0*

    ];

    function renderTeam() {
      const body = document.getElementById('teamBody');
      body.innerHTML = TEAM.map(m => {
        const posHtml = `<div class="rank-pos ${m.posType}">${m.pos}</div>`;
        const weekCls = m.week.startsWith('-') ? 'td-week neg' : 'td-week';
        const statusHtml = m.status === 'active'
          ? '<span class="chip-active">ACTIVE</span>'
          : '<span class="chip-warning">WARNING</span>';
        return `<tr>
      <td>${posHtml}</td>
      <td>
        <div class="hunter-cell">
          <div class="h-avatar" style="border-color:${m.color};color:${m.color};background:${m.color}15">${m.initials}</div>
          <span class="h-name">${m.name}</span>
          ${m.you ? '<span class="you-tag">YOU</span>' : ''}
        </div>
      </td>
      <td class="td-pts">${m.pts}</td>
      <td class="${weekCls}">${m.week}</td>
      <td class="td-streak">🔥 ${m.streak}</td>
      <td>${statusHtml}</td>
      <td>
        <div class="actions-cell">
          <button class="btn-pts-pos" onclick="openAddPoints('${m.name}')">+ Points</button>
          <button class="btn-pts-neg" onclick="openDeductPoints('${m.name}')">- Points</button>
          <button class="btn-warn" onclick="openWarn('${m.name}')">Warn</button>
          <button class="btn-overflow"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="5" r="1"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1"/><circle cx="12" cy="19" r="1"/></svg></button>
        </div>
      </td>
    </tr>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    function openAddPoints(name) {
      document.querySelector('.rp-section:first-child .form-input').value = name;
    }
    function openDeductPoints(name) {
      document.querySelector('.rp-section:first-child .form-input').value = name;
    }
    function openWarn(name) {
      document.querySelector('.rp-section:last-child .form-input').value = name;
    }

    document.getElementById('collapseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
      sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
      const ic = document.getElementById('collapseIcon');
      ic.innerHTML = sb.classList.contains('collapsed')
        ? '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="14 9 17 12 14 15"/>'
        : '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="16 15 13 12 16 9"/>';
    });

    renderTeam();
  </script>
</body>

</html>

function showToast(msg) {
  let c = document.getElementById('toast-container');
  if (!c) { c = document.createElement('div'); c.id = 'toast-container'; c.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;'; document.body.appendChild(c); }
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.style.cssText = `padding:12px 20px;border-radius:6px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #4FC3F7;color:#4FC3F7;background:rgba(79,195,247,0.1);animation:fadeIn 0.3s ease;max-width:340px;`;
  t.textContent = msg;
  c.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 3500);
}

let currentTab = 'all';
let searchQuery = '';
let activeQuests = [...ALL_TASKS];

function init() {
  const pSelect = document.getElementById('fProject');
  PROJECTS.forEach(p => {
    pSelect.innerHTML += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.name}</option>`;
  });
  renderQuests();
}

function onProjectSelect() {
  const pid = document.getElementById('fProject').value;
  const p = PROJECTS.find(x => x.id === pid);
  if(p) {
    document.getElementById('fLead').value = p.lead;
    const aSelect = document.getElementById('fAssignTo');
    aSelect.disabled = false;
    aSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="" disabled selected>Select member</option>' + p.members.map(m => `<option value="${m}">${m}</option>`).join('');
  }
}

function assignTask() {
  showToast("Task assignment will connect to backend in the next phase.");
  document.getElementById('fProject').selectedIndex = 0;
  document.getElementById('fLead').value = '';
  document.getElementById('fTitle').value = '';
  document.getElementById('fAssignTo').innerHTML = '<option value="" disabled selected>Select project first</option>';
  document.getElementById('fAssignTo').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('fDuration').value = '';
  document.getElementById('fDeadline').value = '';
  document.getElementById('fPriority').selectedIndex = 0;
}

function switchTab(el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => {
    t.style.color = 'var(--text2)';
    t.style.borderBottomColor = 'transparent';
    t.style.background = 'transparent';
  });
  el.style.color = 'var(--blue)';
  el.style.borderBottomColor = 'var(--blue)';
  el.style.background = 'rgba(79,195,247,0.05)';
  currentTab = el.dataset.val;
  renderQuests();
}

function filterQuests(q) {
  searchQuery = q.toLowerCase();
  renderQuests();
}

function priorityChip(p) {
  if(p===1) return '<span class="chip chip-high">HIGH</span>';
  if(p===2) return '<span class="chip chip-medium">MEDIUM</span>';
  return '<span class="chip chip-low">LOW</span>';
}

function statusChip(s, r) {
  if(s==='in_progress') return '<span class="chip chip-progress">IN PROGRESS</span>';
  if(s==='pending')     return '<span class="chip chip-pending">PENDING</span>';
  if(s==='completed' && !r) return '<span class="chip chip-completed">COMPLETED</span>';
  if(s==='rated')       return '<span class="chip chip-rated" style="background:rgba(154,123,255,0.1);border-color:rgba(154,123,255,0.4);color:var(--purple);">RATED</span>';
  return '';
}

function rateCell(t) {
  if(t.status === 'completed' && !t.rating) {
    return `<select class="rate-select" onchange="handleRate(this, ${t.id})">
      <option value="">Rate task...</option>
      <option value="3">Needs revision (+3 pts)</option>
      <option value="5">Meets expectation (+5 pts)</option>
      <option value="8">Exceeds expectation (+8 pts)</option>
    </select>`;
  }
  if(t.rating) return `<span style="color:var(--purple); font-weight:bold;">${t.rating==='exceeds'?'Exceeds':t.rating==='meets'?'Meets':'Revision'}</span>`;
  return '<span class="rate-dash">—</span>';
}

function renderQuests() {
  let filtered = activeQuests.filter(t => {
    if(searchQuery && !t.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery) && !t.assignedTo.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery)) return false;
    if(currentTab === 'awaiting' && (t.status !== 'completed' || t.rating)) return false;
    if(currentTab === 'rated' && t.status !== 'rated') return false;
    return true;
  });
  
  const body = document.getElementById('questsBody');
  body.innerHTML = filtered.map((q, i) => {
    const p = PROJECTS.find(pr => pr.id === q.projectId);
    return `<tr>
      <td>${i+1}</td>
      <td class="td-title">${q.title}</td>
      <td><div class="assignee-cell">
        <div class="h-avatar" style="border-color:${p.color};color:${p.color};background:${p.color}18">${q.assignedTo.charAt(0)}</div>
        <span class="h-name">${q.assignedTo}</span>
      </div></td>
      <td class="td-deadline">${new Date(q.deadline).toLocaleDateString('en-GB')}</td>
      <td>${priorityChip(q.priority)}</td>
      <td>${statusChip(q.status, q.rating)}</td>
      <td>${rateCell(q)}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');
  
  document.getElementById('pgInfo').textContent = `Showing 1 to ${filtered.length} of ${filtered.length} quests`;
}

function handleRate(sel, id) {
  if(!sel.value) return;
  const task = activeQuests.find(t => t.id === id);
  if(task) {
    task.rating = sel.value === '8' ? 'exceeds' : sel.value === '5' ? 'meets' : 'needs_revision';
    task.points = parseInt(sel.value);
    task.status = 'rated';
  }
  showToast("Rating will be saved to backend in the next phase.");
  renderQuests();
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const RANK_COLORS = { e:'#8A93A8', d:'#CD7F32', c:'#B0B0B0', b:'#4FC3F7', a:'#FFD700', s:'#00E5FF', ss:'#9A7BFF' };

const HUNTERS = [
  { initials:'RV', name:'Riya Sharma',    username:'riya.sharma',    role:'member',      rank:'a',  pts:'12,450', status:'active' },
  { initials:'AS', name:'Aarav Singh',    username:'aarav.singh',    role:'coordinator', rank:'s',  pts:'7,650',  status:'active' },
  { initials:'AV', name:'Arjun Verma',    username:'arjun.verma',    role:'member',      rank:'b',  pts:'5,980',  status:'active' },
  { initials:'PP', name:'Pranav Patil',   username:'pranav.patil',   role:'member',      rank:'c',  pts:'4,820',  status:'active' },
  { initials:'NK', name:'Neha Kulkarni',  username:'neha.kulkarni',  role:'member',      rank:'b',  pts:'4,210',  status:'active' },
  { initials:'AK', name:'Aniket Kamble',  username:'aniket.kamble',  role:'member',      rank:'b',  pts:'3,780',  status:'active' },
  { initials:'SM', name:'Siddhant More',  username:'siddhant.more',  role:'coordinator', rank:'s',  pts:'3,450',  status:'active' },
  { initials:'SP', name:'Sneha Pawar',    username:'sneha.pawar',    role:'member',      rank:'c',  pts:'2,300',  status:'active' },
  { initials:'RK', name:'Ritik Kadam',    username:'ritik.kadam',    role:'member',      rank:'d',  pts:'1,950',  status:'active' },
  { initials:'MB', name:'Mayur Bhosale',  username:'mayur.bhosale',  role:'member',      rank:'e',  pts:'870',    status:'inactive'},
];

function roleLabel(r) {
  if (r === 'coordinator') return '<span class="role-chip role-coordinator">U5 COORDINATOR</span>';
  if (r === 'admin')       return '<span class="role-chip role-admin">ADMIN</span>';
  return                          '<span class="role-chip role-member">MEMBER</span>';
}
function rankHex(r) {
  return `<div class="rank-hex rank-${r}">${r.toUpperCase()}</div>`;
}
function statusChip(s) {
  return s === 'active'
    ? '<span class="chip-active">ACTIVE</span>'
    : '<span class="chip-inactive">INACTIVE</span>';
}

let allHunters = [...HUNTERS];

function renderTable(data) {
  const body = document.getElementById('huntersBody');
  const rc = RANK_COLORS;
  body.innerHTML = data.map(h => {
    const c = rc[h.rank];
    return `<tr>
      <td><div class="name-cell">
        <div class="h-avatar" style="border-color:${c};color:${c};background:${c}18">${h.initials}</div>
        <span class="h-name">${h.name}</span>
      </div></td>
      <td class="td-username">${h.username}</td>
      <td>${roleLabel(h.role)}</td>
      <td>${rankHex(h.rank)}</td>
      <td class="td-pts">${h.pts}</td>
      <td>${statusChip(h.status)}</td>
      <td><div class="actions-cell">
        <button class="btn-edit">Edit</button>
        <button class="btn-deactivate">Deactivate</button>
        <button class="btn-reset">Reset</button>
      </div></td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');
}

function filterTable() {
  const q = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  const filtered = HUNTERS.filter(h => h.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || h.username.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  renderTable(filtered);
  document.getElementById('pgInfo').textContent = `Showing 1 to ${Math.min(10,filtered.length)} of ${filtered.length} hunters`;
}

function setPage(p) {
  [1,2,3].forEach(n => document.getElementById(`pg${n}`).classList.toggle('active', n===p));
  const start = (p-1)*10+1, end = Math.min(p*10,24);
  document.getElementById('pgInfo').textContent = `Showing ${start} to ${end} of 24 hunters`;
}

function createHunter() {
  const name = document.getElementById('fName').value.trim();
  if (!name) return;
  alert(`Hunter "${name}" created successfully.`);
  document.getElementById('fName').value='';
  document.getElementById('fUsername').value='';
  document.getElementById('fPassword').value='';
  document.getElementById('fRole').selectedIndex=0;
}

function togglePw() {
  const pw = document.getElementById('fPassword');
  pw.type = pw.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
}

document.getElementById('collapseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  const ic = document.getElementById('collapseIcon');
  ic.innerHTML = sb.classList.contains('collapsed')
    ? '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="14 9 17 12 14 15"/>'
    : '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="16 15 13 12 16 9"/>';
});

renderTable(HUNTERS);
</script>
</body>
</html>

document.getElementById('collapseBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');

function showToast(msg, type = 'info') {
  let c = document.getElementById('toast-container');
  if (!c) { c = document.createElement('div'); c.id = 'toast-container'; c.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;'; document.body.appendChild(c); }
  const colors = { success:'#00E5FF', error:'#FF1744', info:'#4FC3F7', warning:'#FFB300' };
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.style.cssText = `padding:12px 20px;border-radius:6px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:13px;border:1px solid ${colors[type]};color:${colors[type]};background:${colors[type]}18;animation:fadeIn 0.3s ease;max-width:340px;`;
  t.textContent = msg;
  c.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 3500);
}

const TODAY = '2026-08-16';

const ASSIGNEES = [...new Set(ALL_TASKS.map(t => t.assignedTo))].sort();

const TABS = [
  { id:'all',       label:'All Tasks' },
  { id:'today',     label:"Today's Tasks" },
  { id:'yesterday', label:"Yesterday's Tasks" },
  { id:'week',      label:'This Week' },
  { id:'completed', label:'Completed' },
  { id:'overdue',   label:'Overdue' },
];

function addDays(dateStr, n) {
  const d = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + n);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

const YESTERDAY = addDays(TODAY, -1);
const WEEK_START = (() => {
  const d = new Date(TODAY + 'T00:00:00');
  const dow = (d.getDay() + 6) % 7; // Mon=0
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - dow);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
})();
const WEEK_END = addDays(WEEK_START, 6);

function isOpen(t) { return t.status !== 'completed' && t.status !== 'rated'; }

const TAB_PREDICATES = {
  all:       t => true,
  today:     t => t.deadline === TODAY,
  yesterday: t => t.deadline === YESTERDAY,
  week:      t => t.deadline >= WEEK_START && t.deadline <= WEEK_END,
  completed: t => t.status === 'completed' || t.status === 'rated',
  overdue:   t => isOpen(t) && t.deadline < TODAY,
};

let activeTab = 'all';
let searchText = '';
let filters = { status: [], priority: [], projectIds: [], assignees: [], dateFrom: '', dateTo: '' };
let currentPage = 1;
let PER_PAGE = 10;
let filteredTasks = ALL_TASKS;

function srNumber(id) {
  return 'SR-2026-' + String(100 + id).padStart(5, '0');
}

function priorityChip(p) {
  if (p === 1) return `<span class="chip chip-high">High</span>`;
  if (p === 2) return `<span class="chip chip-medium">Medium</span>`;
  return `<span class="chip chip-low">Low</span>`;
}
function priorityLabel(p) { return p === 1 ? 'High' : p === 2 ? 'Medium' : 'Low'; }

function statusChip(t) {
  if (t.status === 'pending') return `<span class="chip chip-pending">Pending</span>`;
  if (t.status === 'in_progress') return `<span class="chip chip-progress">In Progress</span>`;
  if (t.status === 'completed' && !t.rating) return `<span class="chip chip-completed">Completed</span>`;
  if (t.status === 'rated') return `<span class="chip chip-rated">Rated</span>`;
  return '';
}
function statusLabel(t) {
  if (t.status === 'pending') return 'Pending';
  if (t.status === 'in_progress') return 'In Progress';
  if (t.status === 'completed' && !t.rating) return 'Completed';
  if (t.status === 'rated') return 'Rated';
  return t.status;
}

function fmtDate(dateStr) {
  return new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-US', { day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric' });
}

function renderTabs() {
  document.getElementById('tabBar').innerHTML = TABS.map(tb =>
    `<div class="tab ${tb.id === activeTab ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="setTab('${tb.id}')">${tb.label}</div>`
  ).join('');
}

function setTab(id) {
  activeTab = id;
  currentPage = 1;
  renderTabs();
  updateTable();
}

function onSearchInput(v) {
  searchText = v.trim().toLowerCase();
  currentPage = 1;
  updateTable();
}

function setPageSize(v) {
  PER_PAGE = parseInt(v, 10);
  currentPage = 1;
  renderTable();
}

/* ---------- filter modal ---------- */

function buildFilterModalOptions() {
  const statusDefs = [
    { v:'pending', l:'Pending' }, { v:'in_progress', l:'In Progress' },
    { v:'completed', l:'Completed' }, { v:'rated', l:'Rated' },
  ];
  document.getElementById('fStatus').innerHTML = statusDefs.map(s =>
    `<label class="filter-check ${filters.status.includes(s.v) ? 'checked' : ''}">
      <input type="checkbox" value="${s.v}" ${filters.status.includes(s.v) ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleFilter('status','${s.v}',this)">${s.l}
    </label>`).join('');

  const prioDefs = [{v:1,l:'High'},{v:2,l:'Medium'},{v:3,l:'Low'}];
  document.getElementById('fPriority').innerHTML = prioDefs.map(p =>
    `<label class="filter-check ${filters.priority.includes(p.v) ? 'checked' : ''}">
      <input type="checkbox" value="${p.v}" ${filters.priority.includes(p.v) ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleFilter('priority',${p.v},this)">${p.l}
    </label>`).join('');

  document.getElementById('fProject').innerHTML = PROJECTS.map(p =>
    `<label class="filter-check ${filters.projectIds.includes(p.id) ? 'checked' : ''}">
      <input type="checkbox" value="${p.id}" ${filters.projectIds.includes(p.id) ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleFilter('projectIds','${p.id}',this)">${p.name}
    </label>`).join('');

  document.getElementById('fAssignee').innerHTML = ASSIGNEES.map(a =>
    `<label class="filter-check ${filters.assignees.includes(a) ? 'checked' : ''}">
      <input type="checkbox" value="${a}" ${filters.assignees.includes(a) ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleFilter('assignees','${a}',this)">${a}
    </label>`).join('');

  document.getElementById('fDateFrom').value = filters.dateFrom;
  document.getElementById('fDateTo').value = filters.dateTo;
}

function toggleFilter(group, value, el) {
  const arr = filters[group];
  const idx = arr.indexOf(value);
  if (idx === -1) arr.push(value); else arr.splice(idx, 1);
  el.closest('.filter-check').classList.toggle('checked', idx === -1);
}

function openFilterModal() {
  buildFilterModalOptions();
  document.getElementById('filterOverlay').classList.add('open');
}
function closeFilterModal() {
  document.getElementById('filterOverlay').classList.remove('open');
}
function applyFilterModal() {
  filters.dateFrom = document.getElementById('fDateFrom').value;
  filters.dateTo = document.getElementById('fDateTo').value;
  currentPage = 1;
  closeFilterModal();
  updateTable();
}
function clearFilterModal() {
  filters = { status: [], priority: [], projectIds: [], assignees: [], dateFrom: '', dateTo: '' };
  buildFilterModalOptions();
}

function activeFilterCount() {
  return filters.status.length + filters.priority.length + filters.projectIds.length + filters.assignees.length
    + (filters.dateFrom ? 1 : 0) + (filters.dateTo ? 1 : 0);
}

function updateFilterBadge() {
  const n = activeFilterCount();
  const badge = document.getElementById('filterBadge');
  badge.textContent = n;
  badge.style.display = n > 0 ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
}

/* ---------- filtering + render ---------- */

function getFilteredTasks() {
  return ALL_TASKS.filter(t => {
    if (!TAB_PREDICATES[activeTab](t)) return false;

    if (searchText) {
      const p = PROJECTS.find(pr => pr.id === t.projectId);
      const hay = `${t.title} ${p ? p.name : ''} ${t.assignedTo} ${t.lead}`.toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(searchText)) return false;
    }

    if (filters.status.length && !filters.status.includes(t.status)) return false;
    if (filters.priority.length && !filters.priority.includes(t.priority)) return false;
    if (filters.projectIds.length && !filters.projectIds.includes(t.projectId)) return false;
    if (filters.assignees.length && !filters.assignees.includes(t.assignedTo)) return false;
    if (filters.dateFrom && t.deadline < filters.dateFrom) return false;
    if (filters.dateTo && t.deadline > filters.dateTo) return false;

    return true;
  });
}

function updateTable() {
  filteredTasks = getFilteredTasks();
  updateFilterBadge();
  renderTable();
}

function renderTable() {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('taskBody');
  const pgInfo = document.getElementById('pgInfo');
  const pgC = document.getElementById('pgControls');

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredTasks.length / PER_PAGE));
  if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;
  const start = filteredTasks.length ? (currentPage - 1) * PER_PAGE : 0;
  const end = Math.min(start + PER_PAGE, filteredTasks.length);
  const pageTasks = filteredTasks.slice(start, end);

  pgInfo.innerText = `Showing ${filteredTasks.length ? start + 1 : 0} to ${end} of ${filteredTasks.length} tasks`;

  let pgHtml = `<button class="pg-btn" onclick="setPage(${currentPage-1})" ${currentPage===1?'disabled':''}>&lt;</button>`;
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    pgHtml += `<button class="pg-btn ${i===currentPage?'active':''}" onclick="setPage(${i})">${i}</button>`;
  }
  pgHtml += `<button class="pg-btn" onclick="setPage(${currentPage+1})" ${currentPage===totalPages?'disabled':''}>&gt;</button>`;
  pgC.innerHTML = pgHtml;

  if (!pageTasks.length) {
    tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align:center; padding:32px; color:var(--text2);">No tasks match the current view.</td></tr>`;
    return;
  }

  tbody.innerHTML = pageTasks.map((t, idx) => {
    const p = PROJECTS.find(pr => pr.id === t.projectId);
    const isPast = isOpen(t) && t.deadline < TODAY;
    const dlColor = isPast ? 'var(--red)' : 'var(--text2)';

    return `<tr>
      <td>${start + idx + 1}</td>
      <td style="color:var(--text2); font-size:12px;">${srNumber(t.id)}</td>
      <td><div class="pill-proj" style="background:${p.color}26; color:${p.color}; border-color:${p.color}" onclick="window.location.href='project.html?id=${p.id}'">${p.name}</div></td>
      <td><div style="font-weight:bold;color:white;">${t.title}</div><div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text2)">${t.duration}h</div></td>
      <td style="color:var(--text2)">${t.lead}</td>
      <td>
        <div class="avatar-chip" onclick="window.location.href='hunter.html?name=' + encodeURIComponent('${t.assignedTo}')">
          <div class="avatar-circle" style="background:${p.color}33; border-color:${p.color}; color:${p.color}">${t.assignedTo.charAt(0)}</div>
          ${t.assignedTo}
        </div>
      </td>
      <td style="color:${dlColor}">${fmtDate(t.deadline)}</td>
      <td>${statusChip(t)}</td>
      <td>${priorityChip(t.priority)}</td>
      <td>
        <div class="actions-cell">
          <button class="action-icon-btn" title="View" onclick="openTaskPopover(event, ${t.id})">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>
          </button>
          <button class="action-icon-btn" title="More" onclick="taskActionsMenu(${t.id})">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="5" r="1.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="19" r="1.5"/></svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      </td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');
}

function setPage(p) {
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredTasks.length / PER_PAGE));
  if (p < 1 || p > totalPages) return;
  currentPage = p;
  renderTable();
}

/* ---------- task popover + actions ---------- */

function closeTaskPopover() {
  document.getElementById('taskPopoverEl')?.remove();
  document.removeEventListener('click', popoverOutsideClick, true);
}
function popoverOutsideClick(e) {
  const el = document.getElementById('taskPopoverEl');
  if (el && !el.contains(e.target)) closeTaskPopover();
}

function openTaskPopover(evt, id) {
  evt.stopPropagation();
  closeTaskPopover();
  const t = ALL_TASKS.find(x => x.id === id);
  const p = PROJECTS.find(pr => pr.id === t.projectId);
  const rect = evt.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();

  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'task-popover';
  el.id = 'taskPopoverEl';
  el.style.top = Math.min(rect.bottom + 8, window.innerHeight - 280) + 'px';
  el.style.left = Math.min(rect.left - 240, window.innerWidth - 300) + 'px';
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="tp-title">${t.title}</div>
    <div class="tp-row"><span class="tp-label">SR Number</span><span class="tp-val">${srNumber(t.id)}</span></div>
    <div class="tp-row"><span class="tp-label">Project</span><span class="tp-val" style="color:${p.color}">${p.name}</span></div>
    <div class="tp-row"><span class="tp-label">Assigned by</span><span class="tp-val">${t.lead}</span></div>
    <div class="tp-row"><span class="tp-label">Assigned to</span><span class="tp-val">${t.assignedTo}</span></div>
    <div class="tp-row"><span class="tp-label">Deadline</span><span class="tp-val">${fmtDate(t.deadline)}</span></div>
    <div class="tp-row"><span class="tp-label">Priority</span><span class="tp-val">${priorityLabel(t.priority)}</span></div>
    <div class="tp-row"><span class="tp-label">Status</span><span class="tp-val">${statusLabel(t)}</span></div>
    <div class="tp-row"><span class="tp-label">Points</span><span class="tp-val">${t.points || '—'}</span></div>
  `;
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener('click', popoverOutsideClick, true), 0);
}

function taskActionsMenu(id) {
  showToast('Task actions coming soon', 'info');
}

/* ---------- CSV export ---------- */

function csvEscape(v) {
  const s = String(v ?? '');
  return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : s;
}

function exportCSV() {
  const rows = [
    ['SR Number', 'Project', 'Task', 'Assigned By', 'Assigned To', 'Deadline', 'Status', 'Priority'],
    ...filteredTasks.map(t => {
      const p = PROJECTS.find(pr => pr.id === t.projectId);
      return [srNumber(t.id), p.name, t.title, t.lead, t.assignedTo, t.deadline, statusLabel(t), priorityLabel(t.priority)];
    }),
  ];
  const csv = rows.map(r => r.map(csvEscape).join(',')).join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `all-tasks-${TODAY}.csv`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showToast(`Exported ${filteredTasks.length} tasks`, 'success');
}

function init() {
  renderTabs();
  updateTable();
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
// ── MEMBER DATA ──────────────────────────────────────
const MEMBERS = [

  { initials:'SP', name:'Sneha Pawar',    time:'09:30 AM', status:'present',      color:'#4FC3F7' },
  { initials:'RJ', name:'Rohan Jadhav',   time:'--:--',    status:'not_recorded', color:'#8A8AA3' },
];

const ATTENDANCE_DATA = [
  { date:'2026-08-15', checkIn:'10:21', checkOut:'--:--', duration:'00h 00m', override:false },
  { date:'2026-08-14', checkIn:'10:27', checkOut:'--:--', duration:'00h 00m', override:false },
  { date:'2026-08-13', checkIn:'09:49', checkOut:'23:45', duration:'13h 55m', override:false },
  { date:'2026-08-12', checkIn:'11:00', checkOut:'22:22', duration:'11h 06m', override:true  },
  { date:'2026-08-11', checkIn:'15:58', checkOut:'23:45', duration:'07h 47m', override:false },
  { date:'2026-08-10', checkIn:'09:15', checkOut:'21:10', duration:'11h 55m', override:false },
];

function statusChipHtml(status) {
  if (status === 'present')      return '<span class="status-chip status-present">PRESENT</span>';
  if (status === 'late')         return '<span class="status-chip status-late">LATE</span>';
  if (status === 'absent')       return '<span class="status-chip status-absent">ABSENT</span>';
  if (status === 'not_recorded') return '<span class="status-chip status-not-recorded">NOT RECORDED</span>';
  return '';
}

// ── RENDER MEMBER CARDS ───────────────────────────────
const MAX_VISIBLE_CARDS = 6;
let memberCardsExpanded = false;

function memberCardHtml(m) {
  return `
    <div class="member-card" onclick="openDetail('${m.initials}','${m.name}')">
      <div class="mc-top">
        <div class="mc-avatar" style="border-color:${m.color};color:${m.color};background:${m.color}18">${m.initials}</div>
        <div class="mc-info">
          <div class="mc-name">${m.name}</div>
          <div class="mc-time">${m.time}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      ${statusChipHtml(m.status)}
      <button class="btn-log" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-7"/><path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 013 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z"/></svg>
        Log
      </button>
    </div>
  `;
}

function toggleMemberCards() {
  memberCardsExpanded = !memberCardsExpanded;
  renderMemberCards();
}

function renderMemberCards() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('memberCards');
  const total = MEMBERS.length;
  const overflow = total > MAX_VISIBLE_CARDS;

  // Column count = however many tiles are on screen right now, capped at 6,
  // so the row always divides evenly (1 card = full width, 2 = 50/50, etc).
  const cols = Math.min(total, MAX_VISIBLE_CARDS);
  wrap.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, 1fr)`;

  if (!overflow) {
    wrap.innerHTML = MEMBERS.map(memberCardHtml).join('');
    return;
  }

  if (!memberCardsExpanded) {
    // Show 5 cards + a "+N more" tile as the 6th, so the row still fills evenly.
    const visible = MEMBERS.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_CARDS - 1);
    const hiddenCount = total - visible.length;
    wrap.innerHTML = visible.map(memberCardHtml).join('') + `
      <div class="member-card more-toggle" onclick="toggleMemberCards()">
        <div class="more-count">+${hiddenCount}</div>
        <div class="more-label">MORE ▾</div>
      </div>`;
  } else {
    // Expanded: show everyone, wrapping onto extra rows of up to 6, with a
    // trailing "show less" tile.
    wrap.innerHTML = MEMBERS.map(memberCardHtml).join('') + `
      <div class="member-card more-toggle" onclick="toggleMemberCards()">
        <div class="more-label">SHOW LESS ▴</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

// ── RENDER ATTENDANCE TABLE ───────────────────────────
function renderAttendanceTable() {
  const body = document.getElementById('detailBody');
  body.innerHTML = ATTENDANCE_DATA.map(r => `
    <tr>
      <td class="td-date">${r.date}</td>
      <td class="td-time">${r.checkIn}</td>
      <td class="td-time">${r.checkOut}</td>
      <td class="td-dur">${r.duration}</td>
      <td>
        <div class="status-cell">
          <span class="chip-present">PRESENT</span>
          ${r.override ? '<span class="chip-override">OVERRIDE</span>' : ''}
        </div>
      </td>
    </tr>
  `).join('');
}

// ── DETAIL OPEN/CLOSE ─────────────────────────────────
function openDetail(initials, name) {
  document.getElementById('detailPanel').style.display = 'flex';
  renderAttendanceTable();
}
function closeDetail() {
  document.getElementById('detailPanel').style.display = 'none';
}

// ── DETAIL TABS ───────────────────────────────────────
function switchDTab(el, tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.dtab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
}

// ── SIDEBAR COLLAPSE ──────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById('collapseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  const ic = document.getElementById('collapseIcon');
  ic.innerHTML = sb.classList.contains('collapsed')
    ? '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="14 9 17 12 14 15"/>'

});

   and topbar, extracted from dashboard.html's "Command Centre"

   "active" nav item and page-specific topbar content differ.
   Page-specific components (tables, forms, podiums, charts, etc.)
   stay defined inline in each page's own <style> block.

function showToast(msg, type = 'info') {
  let c = document.getElementById('toast-container');
  if (!c) { c = document.createElement('div'); c.id = 'toast-container'; c.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;'; document.body.appendChild(c); }
  const colors = { success:'#00E5FF', error:'#FF1744', info:'#4FC3F7', warning:'#FFB300' };
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.style.cssText = `padding:12px 20px;border-radius:6px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:13px;border:1px solid ${colors[type]};color:${colors[type]};background:${colors[type]}18;animation:fadeIn 0.3s ease;max-width:340px;`;
  t.textContent = msg;
  c.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 3500);
}


const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const memberName = decodeURIComponent(params.get('name') || '');
const memberTasks = ALL_TASKS.filter(t => t.assignedTo === memberName);
const isU5 = U5_LEADS.includes(memberName);

if(memberTasks.length === 0) {
  document.getElementById('mainContent').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('errorState').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('pt-name').innerText = memberName || 'UNKNOWN';
} else {
  document.getElementById('pt-name').innerText = memberName;
  document.getElementById('p-name').innerText = memberName;
  document.getElementById('p-av').innerText = memberName.charAt(0);
  document.getElementById('p-role').innerText = isU5 ? 'U5 Coordinator' : 'Team Member';
  
  const compTasks = memberTasks.filter(t => t.status==='completed' || t.status==='rated');
  const ratTasks = memberTasks.filter(t => t.rating);
  const totPts = ratTasks.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.points, 0);
  
  document.getElementById('ps-ass').innerText = memberTasks.length;
  document.getElementById('ps-comp').innerText = compTasks.length;
  document.getElementById('ps-rat').innerText = ratTasks.length;
  document.getElementById('ps-pts').innerText = totPts;
  
  // Projects
  const uProjs = [...new Set(memberTasks.map(t=>t.projectId))];
  const pRow = document.getElementById('projRow');
  uProjs.forEach(pid => {
    const p = PROJECTS.find(x => x.id === pid);
    if(p) {
      pRow.innerHTML += `<div class="proj-pill" style="background:${p.color}26; border-color:${p.color}" onclick="window.location.href='project.html?id=${pid}'">
        <span class="pp-name" style="color:${p.color}">${p.name}</span>
        <span class="pp-lead" style="color:${p.color}">Lead: ${p.lead}</span>
      </div>`;
    }
  });
  
  // Table
  let currentTab = 'all';
  function renderTable() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('tBody');
    const filtered = currentTab === 'all' ? memberTasks : memberTasks.filter(t => t.status === currentTab || (currentTab==='completed' && t.status==='rated'));
    
    tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map((t, idx) => {
      const p = PROJECTS.find(pr => pr.id === t.projectId);
      
      let prioHtml = '';
      if(t.priority===1) prioHtml = `<span class="chip chip-high">High</span>`;
      else if(t.priority===2) prioHtml = `<span class="chip chip-medium">Medium</span>`;
      else prioHtml = `<span class="chip chip-low">Low</span>`;
      
      let statHtml = '';
      if(t.status==='pending') statHtml = `<span class="chip chip-pending">Pending</span>`;
      else if(t.status==='in_progress') statHtml = `<span class="chip chip-progress">In Progress</span>`;
      else if(t.status==='completed' && !t.rating) statHtml = `<span class="chip chip-completed">Completed</span>`;
      else if(t.status==='rated') statHtml = `<span class="chip chip-rated">Rated</span>`;
      
      let ratHtml = '<span style="color:var(--text3)">—</span>';
      if(t.rating) {
        const lbl = t.rating === 'exceeds' ? 'Exceeds Expectation' : t.rating === 'meets' ? 'Meets Expectation' : 'Needs Revision';
        const cls = t.rating === 'exceeds' ? 'rating-exceeds' : t.rating === 'meets' ? 'rating-meets' : 'rating-revision';
        ratHtml = `<span class="${cls}">${lbl}</span>`;
      }
      
      let ptsHtml = '<span style="color:var(--text3)">—</span>';
      if(t.rating) ptsHtml = `<span style="color:var(--teal);font-weight:700;">+${t.points}</span>`;
      
      return `<tr>
        <td style="text-align:center;color:var(--text2)">${idx + 1}</td>
        <td style="font-weight:bold">${t.title}</td>
        <td><div class="pill-proj" style="background:${p.color}26; color:${p.color}; border-color:${p.color}; font-size:10px; padding:2px 8px;" onclick="window.location.href='project.html?id=${p.id}'">${p.name}</div></td>
        <td style="color:var(--text2)">${t.lead}</td>
        <td>${new Date(t.deadline).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {day:'numeric', month:'short'})}</td>
        <td>${prioHtml}</td>
        <td>${statHtml}</td>
        <td>${ratHtml}</td>
        <td>${ptsHtml}</td>
      </tr>`;
    }).join('');
  }
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      el.classList.add('active');
      currentTab = el.dataset.val;
      renderTable();
    });
  });
  
  renderTable();
  
  // Points Summary
  const ex = ratTasks.filter(t=>t.rating==='exceeds').length;
  const me = ratTasks.filter(t=>t.rating==='meets').length;
  const nr = ratTasks.filter(t=>t.rating==='needs_revision').length;
  
  document.getElementById('pc-tit').innerText = `Points earned from tasks this member: ${totPts}`;
  document.getElementById('pc-desc').innerText = `Breakdown: Exceeds ×${ex} (+8 each) | Meets ×${me} (+5 each) | Needs Revision ×${nr} (+3 each)`;
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

// ─── SIDEBAR COLLAPSE ─────────────────────────────────
    document.getElementById('collapseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
      const ic = document.getElementById('collapseIcon');
      sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
      ic.innerHTML = sb.classList.contains('collapsed')
        ? '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="14 9 17 12 14 15"/>'
        : '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="16 15 13 12 16 9"/>';
    });

    // ─── CHART ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const members = [
      { name: 'Riya', initials: 'RV', pts: 420, rank: 'S', color: '#9b59ff' },
      { name: 'Aarav', initials: 'AS', pts: 365, rank: 'S', color: '#00c8ff' },
      { name: 'Arjun', initials: 'AV', pts: 310, rank: 'B', color: '#f5a623' },
      { name: 'Pranav', initials: 'PP', pts: 250, rank: 'B', color: '#3a7bd5' },
      { name: 'Neha', initials: 'NK', pts: 180, rank: 'B', color: '#778899' },
      { name: 'Aniket', initials: 'AK', pts: 120, rank: 'D', color: '#cc8844' },
      { name: 'Siddhant', initials: 'SM', pts: 60, rank: 'D', color: '#556677' },
    ];

    const rankThresholds = [
      { label: 'SS', val: 450, color: '#00e5ff' },
      { label: 'S', val: 350, color: '#9b59ff' },
      { label: 'B', val: 250, color: '#f5a623' },
      { label: 'D', val: 100, color: '#778899' },
    ];

    // Custom plugin: circular initials avatars on top of bars + rank threshold lines
    const avatarPlugin = {
      id: 'avatarPlugin',
      afterDatasetsDraw(chart) {
        const { ctx, data, scales } = chart;
        const xScale = scales.x, yScale = scales.y;
        data.datasets[0].data.forEach((val, i) => {
          const x = xScale.getPixelForValue(i);
          const y = yScale.getPixelForValue(val);
          const member = members[i];
          const r = 14;
          // circle bg
          ctx.save();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(x, y - r - 4, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1a2d';
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = member.color;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.restore();
          // initials
          ctx.save();
          ctx.font = 'bold 9px Rajdhani, sans-serif';
          ctx.fillStyle = member.color;
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.fillText(member.initials, x, y - r - 4);
          ctx.restore();
        });
      }
    };

    // Rank threshold dashed lines plugin
    const thresholdPlugin = {
      id: 'thresholdPlugin',
      beforeDatasetsDraw(chart) {
        const { ctx, chartArea, scales } = chart;
        const yScale = scales.y;
        rankThresholds.forEach(t => {
          const y = yScale.getPixelForValue(t.val);
          if (y < chartArea.top || y > chartArea.bottom) return;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
          ctx.moveTo(chartArea.left, y);
          ctx.lineTo(chartArea.right, y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = t.color;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
          ctx.stroke();
          // label on right
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
          ctx.font = '700 10px Orbitron, sans-serif';
          ctx.fillStyle = t.color;
          ctx.textAlign = 'right';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.fillText(t.label, chartArea.right + 22, y);
          ctx.restore();
        });
      }
    };

    // Idempotent: safe even if this script block ever runs more than once
    // in the same JS realm (e.g. injected navigation in the future).
    if (!Chart.registry.plugins.get('barValueLabels')) {
      Chart.register({
        id: 'barValueLabels',
        afterDatasetsDraw(chart) {
          const { ctx, data, scales } = chart;
          const xScale = scales.x, yScale = scales.y;
          data.datasets[0].data.forEach((val, i) => {
            const x = xScale.getPixelForValue(i);
            const y = yScale.getPixelForValue(val);
            ctx.save();
            ctx.font = '700 11px Orbitron, sans-serif';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.fillText(val, x, y + 6);
            ctx.restore();
          });
        }
      });
    }

    let teamChart = null;

    function initTeamChart() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('teamChart');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      // Prevent ghost/duplicate charts if this ever runs twice (e.g. bfcache pageshow).
      if (teamChart) {
        teamChart.destroy();
        teamChart = null;
      }

      // gradient bars
      const gradients = members.map(m => {
        const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 220);
        g.addColorStop(0, m.color);
        g.addColorStop(1, m.color + '44');
        return g;
      });

      teamChart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'bar',
        plugins: [thresholdPlugin, avatarPlugin],
        data: {
          labels: members.map(m => m.name),
          datasets: [{
            data: members.map(m => m.pts),
            backgroundColor: gradients,
            borderColor: members.map(m => m.color),
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderRadius: 4,
            borderSkipped: false,
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          onClick: (e, elements) => { if (elements.length > 0) { window.location.href = "hunter.html?name=" + encodeURIComponent(members[elements[0].index].name); } },
          onHover: (e, elements) => { e.native.target.style.cursor = elements.length ? "pointer" : "default"; },
          layout: { padding: { top: 30, right: 30, bottom: 0, left: 0 } },
          plugins: {
            legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: {
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(8,15,30,0.95)',
              borderColor: 'rgba(0,200,255,0.3)',
              borderWidth: 1,
              titleColor: '#00c8ff',
              bodyColor: '#8899aa',
              titleFont: { family: 'Orbitron', size: 11, weight: '700' },
              bodyFont: { family: 'Rajdhani', size: 12, weight: '600' },
              padding: 10,
              callbacks: {
                title: items => members[items[0].dataIndex].name,
                label: item => ` ${item.raw} pts  |  Rank ${members[item.dataIndex].rank}`
              }
            }
          },
          scales: {
            x: {
              grid: { display: false },
              border: { display: false },
              ticks: {
                color: '#8899aa',
                font: { family: 'Rajdhani', size: 12, weight: '600' },
              }
            },
            y: {
              min: 0,
              max: 500,
              grid: {
                color: 'rgba(0,200,255,0.05)',
                drawBorder: false,
              },
              border: { display: false, dash: [4, 4] },
              ticks: {
                color: '#445566',
                font: { family: 'Share Tech Mono', size: 10 },
                stepSize: 50,
              }
            }
          },
          animation: {
            duration: 1200,
            easing: 'easeOutQuart'
          }
        }
      });
    }

    initTeamChart();

    // Redraw the chart if this page is restored from the browser's
    // back/forward cache (bfcache) instead of being freshly loaded —
    // canvases aren't reliably repainted on bfcache restore otherwise.
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', (e) => {
      if (e.persisted) initTeamChart();
    });

<script>
const ROWS = [
  { pos:4,  rank:'s', initials:'PP', name:'PRANAV PATIL',    pts:'4,820 PTS', streak:'3w', hero:false, you:false, accentColor:'#00E5FF' },
  { pos:5,  rank:'a', initials:'NK', name:'NEHA KULKARNI',   pts:'4,210 PTS', streak:'2w', hero:false, you:false, accentColor:'#FFD700' },
  { pos:6,  rank:'b', initials:'AK', name:'ANIKET KAMBLE',   pts:'3,780 PTS', streak:'2w', hero:false, you:false, accentColor:'#4FC3F7' },
  { pos:7,  rank:'b', initials:'SM', name:'SIDDHANT MORE',   pts:'3,450 PTS', streak:'1w', hero:false, you:false, accentColor:'#4FC3F7' },
  { pos:8,  rank:'s', initials:'AS', name:'AARAV SINGH',     pts:'2,800 PTS', streak:'1w', hero:false, you:true,  accentColor:'#00E5FF' },
  { pos:9,  rank:'c', initials:'SP', name:'SNEHA PAWAR',     pts:'2,300 PTS', streak:'1w', hero:false, you:false, accentColor:'#B0B0B0' },
  { pos:10, rank:'d', initials:'RK', name:'RITIK KADAM',     pts:'1,950 PTS', streak:'0w', hero:false, you:false, accentColor:'#CD7F32' },
];

const RANK_COLORS = { s:'#00E5FF', a:'#FFD700', b:'#4FC3F7', c:'#B0B0B0', d:'#CD7F32', e:'#8A93A8' };
const ACCENT_COLORS = { 4:'#FFD700', 5:'#FFD700', 6:'#CD7F32', 7:'#4FC3F7', 8:'#4FC3F7' };

function renderRows() {
  const body = document.getElementById('lbBody');
  body.innerHTML = ROWS.map(r => {
    const rc = RANK_COLORS[r.rank];
    const accentColor = r.pos <= 7 ? ACCENT_COLORS[r.pos] || rc : rc;
    return `
    <tr class="${r.you ? 'you-row' : ''}">
      <td class="td-pos">
        <div class="pos-bar" style="background:${accentColor}"></div>
        ${r.pos}
      </td>
      <td><div class="rank-hex-tbl ${r.rank}">${r.rank.toUpperCase()}</div></td>
      <td>
        <div class="hunter-cell">
          <div class="hunter-avatar" style="background:${rc}18;border-color:${rc};color:${rc}">${r.initials}</div>
          <span class="hunter-name">${r.name}</span>
          ${r.you ? '<span class="you-tag">You</span>' : ''}
        </div>
      </td>
      <td class="td-pts">${r.pts}</td>
      <td class="td-streak"><span class="flame">🔥</span> ${r.streak}</td>
      <td class="td-hero">–</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');
}

function switchTab(tab) {
  document.getElementById('tabWeek').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'week');
  document.getElementById('tabMonth').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'month');
}

document.getElementById('collapseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  const ic = document.getElementById('collapseIcon');
  ic.innerHTML = sb.classList.contains('collapsed')
    ? '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="14 9 17 12 14 15"/>'
    : '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="16 15 13 12 16 9"/>';
});

renderRows();
</script>
</body>

  <script>
    // ── Eye toggle ──────────────────────────────────────────
    const eyeBtn = document.getElementById('eyeBtn');
    const eyeIcon = document.getElementById('eyeIcon');
    const eyeOffIcon = document.getElementById('eyeOffIcon');
    const pwInput = document.getElementById('password');

    eyeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const visible = pwInput.type === 'text';
      pwInput.type = visible ? 'password' : 'text';
      eyeIcon.style.display = visible ? 'block' : 'none';
      eyeOffIcon.style.display = visible ? 'none' : 'block';
    });

    // ── Login handler ───────────────────────────────────────
    const loginBtn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
    const errorMsg = document.getElementById('errorMsg');

    async function doLogin() {
      const username = document.getElementById('username').value.trim();
      const password = pwInput.value;

      if (!username || !password) {
        showError('Please enter your hunter ID and access key.');
        return;
      }

      // Loading state
      loginBtn.classList.add('loading');
      loginBtn.disabled = true;
      errorMsg.classList.remove('visible');

      try {
        const res = await fetch('http://localhost:8000/auth/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ username, password })
        });

        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Invalid credentials');

        const data = await res.json();

        // Store JWT in localStorage
        localStorage.setItem('vv_token', data.access_token);
        localStorage.setItem('vv_role', data.role);
        localStorage.setItem('vv_id', data.member_id);
        localStorage.setItem('vv_name', data.name);

        // Redirect
        window.location.href = 'dashboard.html';

      } catch (err) {
        showError('Invalid username or password. Please try again.');
      } finally {
        loginBtn.classList.remove('loading');
        loginBtn.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    function showError(msg) {
      errorMsg.querySelector('span') && (errorMsg.querySelector('span').textContent = msg);
      // Update text node
      const nodes = [...errorMsg.childNodes];
      const textNode = nodes.find(n => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim());
      if (textNode) textNode.textContent = msg;
      else {
        // fallback: set inner content around the svg
        const svg = errorMsg.querySelector('svg');
        errorMsg.innerHTML = '';
        errorMsg.appendChild(svg);
        errorMsg.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ' + msg));
      }
      errorMsg.classList.add('visible');
    }

    // Enter key support
    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') doLogin();
    });

    loginBtn.addEventListener('click', doLogin);

    // Clear error on input
    document.getElementById('username').addEventListener('input', () => errorMsg.classList.remove('visible'));
    pwInput.addEventListener('input', () => errorMsg.classList.remove('visible'));
  </script>
</body>

</html>

const PER_PAGE = 10;
let currentPage = 1;
let activeCategory = 'all';
let activeMember = null;

// ── HELPERS ───────────────────────────────────────────
function initials(name) {
  const parts = name.trim().split(' ');
  if (parts.length >= 2) return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
  return name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

function catChip(cat) {
  const map = {
    attendance: ['cat-attendance', 'ATTENDANCE'],
    task:       ['cat-task',       'TASK'],
    learning:   ['cat-learning',   'LEARNING'],
    content:    ['cat-content',    'CONTENT'],
    streak:     ['cat-streak',     'STREAK'],
    conduct:    ['cat-conduct',    'CONDUCT'],
  };
  const [cls, label] = map[cat] || ['cat-task', cat.toUpperCase()];
  return `<span class="cat-chip ${cls}">${label}</span>`;
}

function ptsCell(log) {
  if (log.type === 'earn')
    return `<span class="pts-earn">+${log.pts}</span>`;
  return `<span class="pts-deduct">${log.pts}</span>`;
}

function computeStats(logs) {
  const earned   = logs.filter(l => l.type === 'earn').reduce((s,l) => s + l.pts, 0);
  const deducted = logs.filter(l => l.type === 'deduct').reduce((s,l) => s + Math.abs(l.pts), 0);
  const net      = earned - deducted;
  return { earned, deducted, net };
}

// ── MEMBER SELECTOR ───────────────────────────────────
function renderMemberSelector() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('memberSelector');
  let html = `<button class="member-pill all-members ${activeMember === null ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="setMember(null)">ALL MEMBERS</button>`;
  html += ALL_MEMBERS.map(m =>
    `<button class="member-pill ${activeMember === m ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="setMember('${m}')">
      <span class="member-avatar-sm">${initials(m)}</span>${m}
    </button>`
  ).join('');
  wrap.innerHTML = html;
}

function setMember(name) {
  activeMember = name;
  currentPage = 1;
  renderMemberSelector();
  render();
}

// ── CATEGORY FILTER ───────────────────────────────────
function setFilter(cat, el) {
  activeCategory = cat;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
  currentPage = 1;
  render();
}

// ── FILTERING ─────────────────────────────────────────
function getFiltered() {
  return ALL_LOGS.filter(l => {
    const catMatch = activeCategory === 'all' || l.cat === activeCategory;
    const memMatch = activeMember === null || l.member === activeMember;
    return catMatch && memMatch;
  });
}

// ── STATS ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function updateStats(stats) {
  const who = activeMember === null ? 'All Members' : activeMember;
  document.getElementById('lblEarn').textContent   = `Total Earned (${who})`;
  document.getElementById('lblDeduct').textContent = `Total Deducted (${who})`;
  document.getElementById('lblNet').textContent    = `Net (${who})`;
  document.getElementById('valEarn').textContent   = `+${stats.earned}`;
  document.getElementById('valDeduct').textContent = `-${stats.deducted}`;
  document.getElementById('valNet').textContent    = `${stats.net >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${stats.net}`;
}

// ── TABLE RENDER ──────────────────────────────────────
function renderTable(logs) {
  const body = document.getElementById('logBody');
  if (!logs.length) {
    body.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; padding:32px; color:var(--text2);">No entries found</td></tr>`;
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = logs.map(l => `
    <tr>
      <td><span class="td-datetime">${l.datetime}</span></td>
      <td>
        <div class="td-member">
          <span class="member-avatar-tbl">${initials(l.member)}</span>
          <span class="member-name-tbl" onclick="setMember('${l.member}')">${l.member}</span>
        </div>
      </td>
      <td>${catChip(l.cat)}</td>
      <td>${ptsCell(l)}</td>
      <td><span class="td-reason">${l.reason}</span></td>
      <td><span class="td-loggedby">${l.by}</span></td>
    </tr>
  `).join('');
}

// ── PAGINATION ────────────────────────────────────────
function updatePagination(total) {
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PER_PAGE));
  if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;
  const start = total === 0 ? 0 : (currentPage - 1) * PER_PAGE + 1;
  const end   = Math.min(currentPage * PER_PAGE, total);
  document.getElementById('pageInfo').textContent =
    total === 0 ? 'No entries found' : `Showing ${start} to ${end} of ${total} entries`;

  const pgC = document.getElementById('pgControls');
  let html = `<button class="pg-btn" onclick="changePage(-1)" ${currentPage===1?'disabled':''}>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"/></svg>
  </button>`;
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    html += `<button class="pg-btn ${i===currentPage?'active':''}" onclick="setPage(${i})">${i}</button>`;
  }
  html += `<button class="pg-btn" onclick="changePage(1)" ${currentPage===totalPages?'disabled':''}>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/></svg>
  </button>`;
  pgC.innerHTML = html;
}

function setPage(p) {
  currentPage = p;
  render();
}
function changePage(dir) {
  render(currentPage + dir);
}

// ── MASTER RENDER ─────────────────────────────────────
function render(forcePage) {
  if (forcePage !== undefined) {
    const filtered = getFiltered();
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PER_PAGE));
    currentPage = Math.max(1, Math.min(totalPages, forcePage));
  }
  const filtered = getFiltered();
  const stats = computeStats(filtered);
  updateStats(stats);
  const paginated = filtered.slice((currentPage - 1) * PER_PAGE, currentPage * PER_PAGE);
  renderTable(paginated);
  updatePagination(filtered.length);
}

// ── SIDEBAR COLLAPSE ──────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById('collapseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  const ic = document.getElementById('collapseIcon');
  ic.innerHTML = sb.classList.contains('collapsed')
    ? '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="14 9 17 12 14 15"/>'
    : '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="16 15 13 12 16 9"/>';
});

// ── SPARKLINES ────────────────────────────────────────
function drawSparkline(id, data, color) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width  = canvas.offsetWidth  || 80;
  const h = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 40;
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const range = max - min || 1;
  const pad = 4;
  const pts = data.map((v, i) => ({
    x: pad + (i / (data.length - 1)) * (w - pad * 2),
    y: h - pad - ((v - min) / range) * (h - pad * 2)
  }));
  // gradient fill
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
  grad.addColorStop(0, color.replace(')', ',0.25)').replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
  grad.addColorStop(1, color.replace(')', ',0.0)').replace('rgb', 'rgba'));
  ctx.beginPath();
  pts.forEach((p, i) => i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y) : ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y));
  ctx.lineTo(pts[pts.length-1].x, h);
  ctx.lineTo(pts[0].x, h);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fill();
  // line
  ctx.beginPath();
  pts.forEach((p, i) => i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y) : ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y));
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();
}

// ── INIT ─────────────────────────────────────────────
renderMemberSelector();
render();
setTimeout(() => {
  drawSparkline('sparkEarn',   [10,40,25,60,80,55,90,70,100,85,110], '#00E5FF');
  drawSparkline('sparkDeduct', [5,15,8,25,10,30,20,35,15,40,25],     '#FF1744');
  drawSparkline('sparkNet',    [5,30,20,50,70,45,80,55,90,70,95],    '#4FC3F7');
}, 100);
</script>

  sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  if (sb.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
    ic.innerHTML = '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="14 9 17 12 14 15"/>';
  } else {
    ic.innerHTML = '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="16 15 13 12 16 9"/>';
  }
});

function showToast(msg, type = 'info') {
  let c = document.getElementById('toast-container');
  if (!c) { c = document.createElement('div'); c.id = 'toast-container'; c.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;'; document.body.appendChild(c); }
  const colors = { success:'#00E5FF', error:'#FF1744', info:'#4FC3F7', warning:'#FFB300' };
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.style.cssText = `padding:12px 20px;border-radius:6px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:13px;border:1px solid ${colors[type]};color:${colors[type]};background:${colors[type]}18;animation:fadeIn 0.3s ease;max-width:340px;`;
  t.textContent = msg;
  c.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 3500);
}


const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const projectId = params.get('id');
const project = PROJECTS.find(p => p.id === projectId);

if(!project) {
  document.getElementById('mainContent').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('errorState').style.display = 'block';
} else {
  const tasks = ALL_TASKS.filter(t => t.projectId === projectId);
  
  // Header
  document.getElementById('pt-name').innerText = project.name;
  
  // Info Card
  document.getElementById('ic-bar').style.background = project.color;
  document.getElementById('ic-hex-o').style.background = project.color;
  document.getElementById('ic-hex-i').style.background = `${project.color}26`;
  document.getElementById('ic-hex-i').style.color = project.color;
  document.getElementById('ic-hex-i').innerText = project.lead.charAt(0);
  document.getElementById('ic-title').innerText = project.name;
  document.getElementById('ic-lead').innerText = project.lead;
  
  // Members
  const mems = project.members;
  const showMems = mems.slice(0, 6);
  let memsHtml = showMems.map(m => `<div class="avatar-circle" style="background:${project.color}33; border-color:${project.color}; color:${project.color};" title="${m}">${m.charAt(0)}</div>`).join('');
  if(mems.length > 6) memsHtml += `<div style="font-size:11px; color:var(--text2); display:flex; align-items:center; margin-left:8px;">+${mems.length - 6} more</div>`;
  document.getElementById('ic-mems').innerHTML = memsHtml;
  
  // Stats
  const tot = tasks.length;
  const inP = tasks.filter(t=>t.status==='in_progress').length;
  const comp = tasks.filter(t=>t.status==='completed' || t.status==='rated').length;
  document.getElementById('sb-tot').innerText = tot;
  document.getElementById('sb-prog').innerText = inP;
  document.getElementById('sb-comp').innerText = comp;
  
  // Progress
  const pct = tot === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((comp / tot) * 100);
  document.getElementById('prog-txt').innerText = `${pct}%`;
  document.getElementById('prog-bar').style.width = `${pct}%`;
  
  // Kanban
  const pends = tasks.filter(t=>t.status==='pending');
  const progs = tasks.filter(t=>t.status==='in_progress');
  const comps = tasks.filter(t=>t.status==='completed' || t.status==='rated');
  
  document.getElementById('hdr-pend').innerText = `PENDING (${pends.length})`;
  document.getElementById('hdr-prog').innerText = `IN PROGRESS (${progs.length})`;
  document.getElementById('hdr-comp').innerText = `COMPLETED / RATED (${comps.length})`;
  
  function buildCard(t) {
    let prioHtml = '';
    if(t.priority===1) prioHtml = `<span class="chip chip-high">High</span>`;
    else if(t.priority===2) prioHtml = `<span class="chip chip-medium">Medium</span>`;
    else prioHtml = `<span class="chip chip-low">Low</span>`;
    
    let statHtml = '';
    if(t.status==='pending') statHtml = `<span class="chip chip-pending">Pending</span>`;
    else if(t.status==='in_progress') statHtml = `<span class="chip chip-progress">In Progress</span>`;
    else if(t.status==='completed' && !t.rating) statHtml = `<span class="chip chip-completed">Completed</span>`;
    else if(t.status==='rated') statHtml = `<span class="chip chip-rated">Rated</span>`;
    
    let footExt = '';
    if(t.status==='completed' && !t.rating) footExt = '<div style="color:var(--amber); font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; margin-top:8px;">⏳ Awaiting Rating</div>';
    else if(t.rating) {
      const lbl = t.rating === 'exceeds' ? 'Exceeds Expectation' : t.rating === 'meets' ? 'Meets Expectation' : 'Needs Revision';
      const cls = t.rating === 'exceeds' ? 'rating-exceeds' : t.rating === 'meets' ? 'rating-meets' : 'rating-revision';
      footExt = `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:8px; align-items:center;"><span class="${cls}">${lbl}</span> <span style="color:var(--teal); font-family:'Bebas Neue'; font-size:16px;">+${t.points}</span></div>`;
    }
    
    return `<div class="k-card" style="border-top-color:${project.color}">
      ${prioHtml}
      <div class="k-title">${t.title}</div>
      <div class="k-info"><div class="avatar-circle" style="width:20px;height:20px;font-size:9px;background:${project.color}33;border-color:${project.color};color:${project.color}">${t.assignedTo.charAt(0)}</div> ${t.assignedTo}</div>
      <div class="k-info">Due: ${new Date(t.deadline).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {day:'numeric', month:'short'})} · ${t.duration}h</div>
      <div class="k-foot">${statHtml}</div>
      ${footExt}
    </div>`;
  }
  
  document.getElementById('col-pend').innerHTML = pends.map(buildCard).join('');
  document.getElementById('col-prog').innerHTML = progs.map(buildCard).join('');
  document.getElementById('col-comp').innerHTML = comps.map(buildCard).join('');
}
</script>

<script>
function togglePw(id, btn) {
  const inp = document.getElementById(id);
  const show = inp.type === 'password';
  inp.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
  btn.innerHTML = show
    ? `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0112 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 015.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0112 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 01-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 11-4.24-4.24"/><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/></svg>`
    : `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>`;
}

document.getElementById('collapseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  const ic = document.getElementById('collapseIcon');
  ic.innerHTML = sb.classList.contains('collapsed')
    ? '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="14 9 17 12 14 15"/>'
    : '<rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="9" y1="3" x2="9" y2="21"/><polyline points="16 15 13 12 16 9"/>';
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

const TODAY = '2026-08-16';

if (!Chart.registry.plugins.get('centerText')) {
  Chart.register({
    id: 'centerText',
    afterDraw(chart) {
      const cfg = chart.config.options.plugins.centerText;
      if (!cfg) return;
      const { ctx, chartArea: { width, height, left, top } } = chart;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.font = "700 22px 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillStyle = cfg.color || '#E8E8F0';
      ctx.fillText(cfg.value, left + width / 2, top + height / 2 - 8);
      ctx.font = "700 9px 'Rajdhani', sans-serif";
      ctx.fillStyle = '#8A8AA3';
      ctx.fillText(cfg.label, left + width / 2, top + height / 2 + 10);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  });
}

function makeDonut(canvasId, labels, values, colors, centerValue, centerLabel) {
  const ctx = document.getElementById(canvasId).getContext('2d');
  return new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'doughnut',
    data: { labels, datasets: [{ data: values, backgroundColor: colors, borderWidth: 0, hoverOffset: 4 }] },
    options: {
      responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '72%',
      plugins: { legend: { display: false }, centerText: { value: centerValue, label: centerLabel } }
    }
  });
}

function renderLegend(containerId, rows) {
  document.getElementById(containerId).innerHTML = rows.map(r => `
    <div class="legend-row">
      <div class="legend-dot" style="background:${r.color}"></div>
      <div class="legend-name">${r.name}</div>
      <div class="legend-val">${r.val}</div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function priorityChip(p) {
  if (p === 1) return '<span class="chip chip-high">High</span>';
  if (p === 2) return '<span class="chip chip-medium">Medium</span>';
  return '<span class="chip chip-low">Low</span>';
}

function statusChip(t) {
  if (t.status === 'pending') return '<span class="chip chip-pending">Pending</span>';
  if (t.status === 'in_progress') return '<span class="chip chip-progress">In Progress</span>';
  if (t.status === 'completed' && !t.rating) return '<span class="chip chip-completed">Completed</span>';
  if (t.status === 'rated') return '<span class="chip chip-rated">Rated</span>';
  return '';
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
}

function init() {
  // ── Row 1: stat strip ──
  const memberSet = new Set();
  PROJECTS.forEach(p => p.members.forEach(m => memberSet.add(m)));
  document.getElementById('st-members').innerText = memberSet.size;

  const totalTasks = ALL_TASKS.length;
  const doneTasks = ALL_TASKS.filter(t => t.status === 'completed' || t.status === 'rated').length;
  const progressPct = totalTasks ? Math.round(doneTasks / totalTasks * 100) : 0;
  document.getElementById('progressRing').style.setProperty('--pct', progressPct);
  document.getElementById('progressRingLabel').innerText = progressPct + '%';
  document.getElementById('st-progress-frac').innerText = `${doneTasks} / ${totalTasks}`;

  document.getElementById('st-projects').innerText = PROJECTS.length;
  document.getElementById('st-points').innerText = ALL_TASKS.reduce((s, t) => s + t.points, 0).toLocaleString();

  // ── Row 2 left: Today's Task Overview donut ──
  const openTasks = ALL_TASKS.filter(t => t.status === 'pending' || t.status === 'in_progress');
  const delayedCount = openTasks.filter(t => t.deadline < TODAY).length;
  const progressCount = openTasks.filter(t => t.status === 'in_progress' && t.deadline >= TODAY).length;
  const pendingCount = openTasks.filter(t => t.status === 'pending' && t.deadline >= TODAY).length;
  const completedCount = doneTasks;

  makeDonut('todayChart',
    ['Completed', 'In Progress', 'Pending', 'Delayed'],
    [completedCount, progressCount, pendingCount, delayedCount],
    ['#00E5FF', '#4FC3F7', '#FFB300', '#FF1744'],
    totalTasks, 'TOTAL TASKS');

  const pct = n => totalTasks ? Math.round(n / totalTasks * 100) : 0;
  renderLegend('todayLegend', [
    { color: '#00E5FF', name: 'Completed', val: `${completedCount} (${pct(completedCount)}%)` },
    { color: '#4FC3F7', name: 'In Progress', val: `${progressCount} (${pct(progressCount)}%)` },
    { color: '#FFB300', name: 'Pending', val: `${pendingCount} (${pct(pendingCount)}%)` },
    { color: '#FF1744', name: 'Delayed', val: `${delayedCount} (${pct(delayedCount)}%)` },

    { icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#8A8AA3" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 00-4-4H5a4 4 0 00-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>', bg:'rgba(138,138,163,0.1)', val: 1, label: 'Member Inactive' },
